ledger.x: c. 388: the Traikutakas appear in Aparanta and southern Gujarat. Infobox "Established: c. 388 CE"; "The dominions of the Traikutakas further included Aparanta and northern Maharashtra." The first named king, Indradatta, is dated 415-440 and "known only from coins minted under his son", so the page leaves 388-415…

c. 550: the Traikutaka line ends with Vikramasena. "the dynasty ended 'around AD 550' when he died" (Vikramasena, dated A.D. 533); the infobox says "Disestablished: c. 456" and the Harishena page "seems to have come to an end around 495", so three pages give three ends.
